title: Demon Reading Under Cherry Tree
description: A black silhouette demon with horns and a long tail sits on a green-draped table, one hand touching an open spellbook with glowing symbols. Three floating picture frames hover above, each containing silhouettes of figures in different scenes, while a flowering yellow cherry blossom branch extends across a swirling blue sky filled with stylized eyes.
prompt: A black silhouette demon with horns and tail sits at a table covered in green cloth, reaching toward an open glowing spellbook. Above, a large flowering yellow cherry blossom branch stretches across a swirling blue sky filled with many stylized watching eyes. Three ornate floating picture frames contain silhouettes of people in different scenes: one under an arch, one by a lake at night, and one reading a book. Pink petals and paint drips fall through the air, vibrant surreal fantasy painting.
